data.body: AC amendment (gap G3 — BLOCKER): Sibling cde1-30ba's action enum must include 'repair_property'. cde1's current DoD wording 'enumerated taxonomy including probe, target, payload, provenance' is ambiguous — 'target/payload/provenance' are dataclass fields, not actions, leaving only 'probe' explicit. Before this story dispatches, verify cde1 has 'repair_property' in its enum (and adds 'clean_label' if T3's failure path needs it). Pre-dispatch grep: `grep -E 'repair_property|clean_label' plugins/dso/scripts/dso_reconciler/<wherever cde1 ships the enum>`. If absent, file a precursor task on cde1's plan extending the enum BEFORE 7a75 dispatch.
